0022600089.text: Both the Utah Jazz and Memphis Grizzlies open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, with Utah on the road. Utah is missing Blake Hinson (hamstring strain), Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps), and Trey Alexander (knee), all listed as out, while Memphis has Isaiah Stewart (ankle) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the most recent meeting, on April 10, 2026 in Salt Lake City, ended with the Jazz winning 147-101.
